# RentFleet — détection consultative de dommages (EfficientNetV2-S)


Ce notebook entraîne un classifieur binaire `aucun dommage visible` / `dommage visible` sur GPU Colab. Il ne détermine jamais la responsabilité, le coût, la retenue ou une décision contractuelle. Toute sortie exige une revue humaine.


Le mode par défaut est `smoke` : il vérifie uniquement le GPU et l'architecture. Le mode `train` refuse de démarrer sans manifeste gelé et preuve de licence officielle. Les données et modèles restent dans le Drive privé; GitHub conserve le code et le protocole.

#@title 1. Monter Drive et vérifier le GPU
from google.colab import drive
drive.mount('/content/drive')

from pathlib import Path
import json, os, subprocess, sys
import torch

print({
    'python': sys.version.split()[0],
    'torch': torch.__version__,
    'cuda': torch.version.cuda,
    'gpu': torch.cuda.get_device_name(0),
})

#@title 2. Récupérer la branche scientifique GitHub
from google.colab import userdata
import base64

REPOSITORY = 'https://github.com/getibplay-cmyk/pfe.git'
GIT_REF = 'science/vehicle-damage-efficientnetv2s'
REPO_DIR = Path('/content/pfe')

def git_environment():
    env = os.environ.copy()
    try:
        token = userdata.get('GITHUB_TOKEN')
    except Exception:
        token = None
    if token:
        basic = base64.b64encode(f'x-access-token:{token}'.encode()).decode()
        env.update({
            'GIT_CONFIG_COUNT': '1',
            'GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0': 'http.https://github.com/.extraheader',
            'GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0': f'AUTHORIZATION: basic {basic}',
        })
    return env

if not REPO_DIR.exists():
    subprocess.run(['git', 'clone', '--filter=blob:none', REPOSITORY, str(REPO_DIR)], check=True, env=git_environment())
subprocess.run(['git', '-C', str(REPO_DIR), 'fetch', 'origin', GIT_REF], check=True, env=git_environment())
subprocess.run(['git', '-C', str(REPO_DIR), 'checkout', '--force', GIT_REF], check=True)
print(subprocess.check_output(['git', '-C', str(REPO_DIR), 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], text=True).strip())

#@title 3. Installer les dépendances scientifiques figées
requirements = REPO_DIR / 'scripts/intelligence/requirements-vehicle-damage-colab.txt'
subprocess.run([
    sys.executable, '-m', 'pip', 'install', '--disable-pip-version-check',
    '--quiet', '--requirement', str(requirements)
], check=True)
subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-m', 'pip', 'check'], check=True)

#@title 4. Paramètres privés Drive — protocole v1.1

OUTPUT = DRIVE_ROOT / 'modeles' / RUN_ID

    'mode': MODE,

#@title 4A. Contrôler, copier et inventorier l'archive HITL
from collections import Counter
from pathlib import PurePosixPath
import hashlib, json, os, time, zipfile

ZIP_DRIVE = DRIVE_ROOT / 'donnees_brutes_privees/Car_parts_and_car_damages_dataset.zip'
ZIP_LOCAL = Path('/content/Car_parts_and_car_damages_dataset.zip')
EXPECTED_SIZE = 3_073_458_211
CHUNK_SIZE = 8 * 1024 * 1024

assert ZIP_DRIVE.is_file(), f'Archive absente: {ZIP_DRIVE}'
source_size = ZIP_DRIVE.stat().st_size
assert source_size == EXPECTED_SIZE, f'Taille inattendue: {source_size} != {EXPECTED_SIZE}'

sha256 = hashlib.sha256()
copied = 0
next_report = 512 * 1024 * 1024
started = time.time()
with ZIP_DRIVE.open('rb') as source, ZIP_LOCAL.open('wb') as target:
    while True:
        chunk = source.read(CHUNK_SIZE)
        if not chunk:
            break
        target.write(chunk)
        sha256.update(chunk)
        copied += len(chunk)
        if copied >= next_report:
            print(f'COPY_PROGRESS {copied}/{source_size}')
            next_report += 512 * 1024 * 1024
    target.flush()
    os.fsync(target.fileno())

assert copied == source_size
assert ZIP_LOCAL.stat().st_size == source_size
digest = sha256.hexdigest()
print(f'COPY_OK bytes={copied} seconds={time.time()-started:.1f} sha256={digest}')

with zipfile.ZipFile(ZIP_LOCAL) as archive:
    bad_member = archive.testzip()
    assert bad_member is None, f'Membre ZIP corrompu: {bad_member}'
    infos = archive.infolist()

files = [info for info in infos if not info.is_dir()]
extensions = Counter((PurePosixPath(info.filename).suffix.lower() or '<none>') for info in files)
top_levels = Counter(PurePosixPath(info.filename).parts[0] for info in files if PurePosixPath(info.filename).parts)
report = {
    'artifact': ZIP_DRIVE.name,
    'source': 'Humans in the Loop - Car Parts and Car Damages Dataset',
    'official_url': 'https://humansintheloop.org/resources/datasets/car-parts-and-car-damages-dataset/',
    'license': 'CC0-1.0',
    'zip_bytes': source_size,
    'sha256': digest,
    'crc_test': 'ok',
    'member_count': len(infos),
    'file_count': len(files),
    'directory_count': len(infos) - len(files),
    'uncompressed_bytes': sum(info.file_size for info in files),
    'compressed_member_bytes': sum(info.compress_size for info in files),
    'extension_counts': dict(sorted(extensions.items())),
    'top_level_counts': dict(sorted(top_levels.items())),
    'first_members': [info.filename for info in files[:30]],
}
report_text = json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + '\n'
LICENSE_ROOT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
report_path = LICENSE_ROOT / 'S7_DAMAGE_HITL_ARCHIVE_REPORT_v1.json'
sha_path = LICENSE_ROOT / 'S7_DAMAGE_HITL_SHA256_v1.txt'
if report_path.exists():
    assert report_path.read_text(encoding='utf-8') == report_text, 'Rapport existant différent'
else:
    report_path.write_text(report_text, encoding='utf-8')
sha_text = f'{digest}  {ZIP_DRIVE.name}\n'
if sha_path.exists():
    assert sha_path.read_text(encoding='utf-8') == sha_text, 'SHA existant différent'
else:
    sha_path.write_text(sha_text, encoding='utf-8')
print(report_text)
print('ARCHIVE_VALIDATED', report_path, sha_path)

#@title 4B. Extraire localement et analyser la structure HITL
from collections import Counter
from pathlib import PurePosixPath
import json, os, time, zipfile

EXTRACT_ROOT = Path('/content/hitl_raw')
MARKER = EXTRACT_ROOT / '.archive_sha256'
started = time.time()

if MARKER.is_file() and MARKER.read_text(encoding='utf-8').strip() == digest:
    print('EXTRACT_REUSED', EXTRACT_ROOT)
else:
    assert not EXTRACT_ROOT.exists() or not any(EXTRACT_ROOT.iterdir()), (
        f'Dossier local non vide sans marqueur compatible: {EXTRACT_ROOT}'
    )
    EXTRACT_ROOT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    root_resolved = EXTRACT_ROOT.resolve()
    with zipfile.ZipFile(ZIP_LOCAL) as archive:
        for info in archive.infolist():
            candidate = (EXTRACT_ROOT / info.filename).resolve()
            assert candidate == root_resolved or root_resolved in candidate.parents, (
                f'Chemin ZIP dangereux: {info.filename}'
            )
        archive.extractall(EXTRACT_ROOT)
    MARKER.write_text(digest + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
    print(f'EXTRACT_OK seconds={time.time()-started:.1f} root={EXTRACT_ROOT}')

all_files = [path for path in EXTRACT_ROOT.rglob('*') if path.is_file() and path != MARKER]
images = [path for path in all_files if path.suffix.lower() in {'.jpg', '.jpeg', '.png'}]
json_files = [path for path in all_files if path.suffix.lower() == '.json']
meta_paths = sorted(path for path in json_files if path.name == 'meta.json')
ann_paths = sorted(path for path in json_files if path.name != 'meta.json')

directory_counts = Counter(str(path.parent.relative_to(EXTRACT_ROOT)) for path in all_files)
print('EXTRACT_COUNTS', {
    'files': len(all_files),
    'images_and_masks': len(images),
    'json': len(json_files),
    'annotation_json': len(ann_paths),
    'meta_json': len(meta_paths),
})
print('DIRECTORY_COUNTS')
for directory, count in sorted(directory_counts.items(), key=lambda item: (-item[1], item[0]))[:40]:
    print(count, directory)

def class_titles(payload):
    result = []
    for item in payload.get('classes', []) if isinstance(payload, dict) else []:
        if isinstance(item, dict):
            result.append(item.get('title') or item.get('name') or str(item))
        else:
            result.append(str(item))
    return result

print('META_SUMMARY')
for path in meta_paths:
    payload = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
    print(json.dumps({
        'path': str(path.relative_to(EXTRACT_ROOT)),
        'keys': sorted(payload.keys()) if isinstance(payload, dict) else [],
        'classes': class_titles(payload),
    }, ensure_ascii=False))

sample_summaries = []
for path in ann_paths[:3] + ann_paths[-3:]:
    payload = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
    objects = payload.get('objects', []) if isinstance(payload, dict) else []
    sample_summaries.append({
        'path': str(path.relative_to(EXTRACT_ROOT)),
        'keys': sorted(payload.keys()) if isinstance(payload, dict) else [],
        'object_count': len(objects) if isinstance(objects, list) else None,
        'classes': sorted(Counter(
            obj.get('classTitle', '<missing>')
            for obj in objects if isinstance(obj, dict)
        ).items()),
    })
print('ANNOTATION_SAMPLES')
print(json.dumps(sample_summaries, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
print('STRUCTURE_ANALYSIS_OK')

#@title 4C. Auditer les images, annotations et doublons
from collections import Counter, defaultdict
from io import BytesIO
from PIL import Image
import hashlib, json, statistics

DAMAGE_CLASSES = {
    'Dent', 'Cracked', 'Scratch', 'Flaking',
    'Broken part', 'Paint chip', 'Missing part', 'Corrosion',
}
PART_CLASSES = {
    'Windshield', 'Back-windshield', 'Front-window', 'Back-window',
    'Front-door', 'Back-door', 'Front-wheel', 'Back-wheel',
    'Front-bumper', 'Back-bumper', 'Headlight', 'Tail-light',
    'Hood', 'Trunk', 'License-plate', 'Mirror', 'Roof', 'Grille',
    'Rocker-panel', 'Quarter-panel', 'Fender',
}
SUBSETS = [
    {
        'canonical_name': 'damage_positive',
        'archive_folder': 'Car parts dataset',
        'label': 1,
        'expected_images': 814,
        'expected_classes': DAMAGE_CLASSES,
    },
    {
        'canonical_name': 'parts_candidate_negative',
        'archive_folder': 'Car damages dataset',
        'label': 0,
        'expected_images': 998,
        'expected_classes': PART_CLASSES,
    },
]

def dhash64(image):
    gray = image.convert('L').resize((9, 8), Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)
    pixels = list(gray.getdata())
    value = 0
    for row in range(8):
        offset = row * 9
        for col in range(8):
            value = (value << 1) | int(pixels[offset + col] > pixels[offset + col + 1])
    return value

def polygon_area(points):
    if not isinstance(points, list) or len(points) < 3:
        return 0.0
    try:
        return abs(sum(
            points[i][0] * points[(i + 1) % len(points)][1]
            - points[(i + 1) % len(points)][0] * points[i][1]
            for i in range(len(points))
        )) / 2.0
    except (TypeError, IndexError):
        return 0.0

records = []
subset_reports = {}
for spec in SUBSETS:
    base = EXTRACT_ROOT / spec['archive_folder'] / 'File1'
    image_dir = base / 'img'
    annotation_dir = base / 'ann'
    meta = json.loads((EXTRACT_ROOT / spec['archive_folder'] / 'meta.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
    meta_classes = {item['title'] for item in meta.get('classes', [])}
    assert meta_classes == spec['expected_classes'], (
        spec['canonical_name'], sorted(meta_classes), sorted(spec['expected_classes'])
    )

    image_paths = sorted(
        path for path in image_dir.iterdir()
        if path.is_file() and path.suffix.lower() in {'.jpg', '.jpeg', '.png'}
    )
    annotation_paths = sorted(annotation_dir.glob('*.json'))
    assert len(image_paths) == spec['expected_images']
    assert len(annotation_paths) == spec['expected_images']

    by_name = {path.name: path for path in image_paths}
    annotated_names = {path.name[:-5] for path in annotation_paths}
    assert set(by_name) == annotated_names, {
        'missing_images': sorted(annotated_names - set(by_name))[:10],
        'missing_annotations': sorted(set(by_name) - annotated_names)[:10],
    }

    class_counts = Counter()
    formats = Counter()
    modes = Counter()
    dimensions = Counter()
    object_counts = []
    area_ratios = []
    annotation_size_mismatches = []
    object_schema = None

    for index, annotation_path in enumerate(annotation_paths, start=1):
        image_name = annotation_path.name[:-5]
        image_path = by_name[image_name]
        payload = json.loads(annotation_path.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
        objects = payload.get('objects', [])
        classes = [obj.get('classTitle') for obj in objects if isinstance(obj, dict)]
        assert set(classes) <= spec['expected_classes'], (annotation_path, sorted(set(classes)))
        assert objects, f'Annotation vide: {annotation_path}'
        class_counts.update(classes)
        object_counts.append(len(objects))

        data = image_path.read_bytes()
        with Image.open(BytesIO(data)) as image:
            image.load()
            width, height = image.size
            image_format = image.format or image_path.suffix.lstrip('.').upper()
            mode = image.mode
            perceptual = dhash64(image)
        assert width > 0 and height > 0
        formats[image_format] += 1
        modes[mode] += 1
        dimensions[(width, height)] += 1

        declared = payload.get('size', {})
        declared_width = declared.get('width') if isinstance(declared, dict) else None
        declared_height = declared.get('height') if isinstance(declared, dict) else None
        if (declared_width, declared_height) != (width, height):
            annotation_size_mismatches.append({
                'image': image_name,
                'actual': [width, height],
                'declared': [declared_width, declared_height],
            })

        polygon_pixels = 0.0
        for obj in objects:
            if object_schema is None and isinstance(obj, dict):
                points = obj.get('points')
                object_schema = {
                    'object_keys': sorted(obj.keys()),
                    'points_keys': sorted(points.keys()) if isinstance(points, dict) else [],
                }
            points = obj.get('points', {}) if isinstance(obj, dict) else {}
            exterior = points.get('exterior', []) if isinstance(points, dict) else []
            polygon_pixels += polygon_area(exterior)
        area_ratios.append(polygon_pixels / (width * height))

        records.append({
            'subset': spec['canonical_name'],
            'archive_folder': spec['archive_folder'],
            'label': spec['label'],
            'image_name': image_name,
            'relative_image': str(image_path.relative_to(EXTRACT_ROOT)),
            'relative_annotation': str(annotation_path.relative_to(EXTRACT_ROOT)),
            'sha256': hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(),
            'dhash64': f'{perceptual:016x}',
            'width': width,
            'height': height,
            'format': image_format,
            'mode': mode,
            'bytes': len(data),
            'object_count': len(objects),
            'annotation_classes': sorted(set(classes)),
            'polygon_area_ratio_sum': polygon_pixels / (width * height),
        })
        if index % 250 == 0:
            print('AUDIT_PROGRESS', spec['canonical_name'], index, len(annotation_paths))

    subset_records = [record for record in records if record['subset'] == spec['canonical_name']]
    subset_reports[spec['canonical_name']] = {
        'archive_folder': spec['archive_folder'],
        'label': spec['label'],
        'image_count': len(subset_records),
        'annotation_count': len(annotation_paths),
        'class_counts': dict(sorted(class_counts.items())),
        'format_counts': dict(sorted(formats.items())),
        'mode_counts': dict(sorted(modes.items())),
        'width_min_median_max': [
            min(record['width'] for record in subset_records),
            statistics.median(record['width'] for record in subset_records),
            max(record['width'] for record in subset_records),
        ],
        'height_min_median_max': [
            min(record['height'] for record in subset_records),
            statistics.median(record['height'] for record in subset_records),
            max(record['height'] for record in subset_records),
        ],
        'file_bytes_total': sum(record['bytes'] for record in subset_records),
        'object_count_min_median_max': [
            min(object_counts), statistics.median(object_counts), max(object_counts),
        ],
        'polygon_area_ratio_sum_min_median_max': [
            min(area_ratios), statistics.median(area_ratios), max(area_ratios),
        ],
        'annotation_size_mismatch_count': len(annotation_size_mismatches),
        'annotation_size_mismatch_examples': annotation_size_mismatches[:10],
        'top_dimensions': [
            {'width': width, 'height': height, 'count': count}
            for (width, height), count in dimensions.most_common(10)
        ],
        'object_schema': object_schema,
    }

exact_groups = defaultdict(list)
for record in records:
    exact_groups[record['sha256']].append(record)
exact_duplicates = [
    {
        'sha256': sha,
        'members': [
            {'subset': record['subset'], 'image_name': record['image_name']}
            for record in group
        ],
    }
    for sha, group in exact_groups.items() if len(group) > 1
]
cross_subset_exact = [
    group for group in exact_duplicates
    if len({member['subset'] for member in group['members']}) > 1
]

positive_hashes = [
    int(record['dhash64'], 16) for record in records
    if record['subset'] == 'damage_positive'
]
negative_hashes = [
    int(record['dhash64'], 16) for record in records
    if record['subset'] == 'parts_candidate_negative'
]
positive_min_distances = [
    min((value ^ candidate).bit_count() for candidate in negative_hashes)
    for value in positive_hashes
]
near_cross_counts = {
    f'le_{threshold}': sum(distance <= threshold for distance in positive_min_distances)
    for threshold in (0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5)
}

audit_report = {
    'archive_sha256': digest,
    'mapping_rule': 'canonical subsets derived from annotation class schema; archive folder names are swapped',
    'records': len(records),
    'subsets': subset_reports,
    'exact_duplicate_group_count': len(exact_duplicates),
    'cross_subset_exact_duplicate_group_count': len(cross_subset_exact),
    'exact_duplicate_examples': exact_duplicates[:20],
    'cross_subset_exact_duplicate_examples': cross_subset_exact[:20],
    'cross_subset_min_dhash_distance': {
        'min': min(positive_min_distances),
        'median': statistics.median(positive_min_distances),
        'max': max(positive_min_distances),
        'counts': near_cross_counts,
    },
}
audit_text = json.dumps(audit_report, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + '\n'
audit_path = LICENSE_ROOT / 'S7_DAMAGE_HITL_DATA_AUDIT_v1.json'
if audit_path.exists():
    assert audit_path.read_text(encoding='utf-8') == audit_text, 'Audit existant différent'
else:
    audit_path.write_text(audit_text, encoding='utf-8')

records_path = Path('/content/S7_DAMAGE_HITL_records_v1.jsonl')
records_path.write_text(
    ''.join(json.dumps(record, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True) + '\n' for record in records),
    encoding='utf-8',
)
print(audit_text)
print('DATA_AUDIT_OK', audit_path, records_path)

#@title 4F. Construire les patches corrigés v1.1 et geler les splits
from collections import Counter, defaultdict
from io import BytesIO
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw
import csv, hashlib, json, random, sys
import numpy as np

PATCH_SIZE = 384
MAX_POSITIVE_PER_IMAGE = 6
NEGATIVE_PER_OVERLAP_IMAGE = 6
SPLIT_SEED = 20260823
PATCH_ROOT = Path('/content/S7_DAMAGE_v1_1')
PATCH_DIR = PATCH_ROOT / 'patches'
assert not PATCH_ROOT.exists(), f'Le dossier existe déjà: {PATCH_ROOT}'
PATCH_DIR.mkdir(parents=True)

records_by_sha = defaultdict(dict)
for record in records:
    records_by_sha[record['sha256']][record['subset']] = record

damage_records = sorted(
    (record for record in records if record['subset'] == 'damage_positive'),
    key=lambda record: record['sha256'],
)
damage_shas = {record['sha256'] for record in damage_records}
overlap_shas = {
    sha for sha, subsets in records_by_sha.items()
    if {'damage_positive', 'parts_candidate_negative'} <= set(subsets)
}
positive_only_shas = damage_shas - overlap_shas
assert len(damage_shas) == 814
assert len(overlap_shas) == 441
assert len(positive_only_shas) == 373

split_order = ('train', 'validation', 'calibration', 'test')
def deterministic_split(groups, salt):
    ordered = sorted(
        groups,
        key=lambda sha: hashlib.sha256(f'{SPLIT_SEED}:{salt}:{sha}'.encode()).hexdigest(),
    )
    count = len(ordered)
    cut_train = int(count * 0.70)
    cut_validation = cut_train + int(count * 0.10)
    cut_calibration = cut_validation + int(count * 0.10)
    assignments = {}
    for index, sha in enumerate(ordered):
        if index < cut_train:
            split = 'train'
        elif index < cut_validation:
            split = 'validation'
        elif index < cut_calibration:
            split = 'calibration'
        else:
            split = 'test'
        assignments[sha] = split
    return assignments

group_splits = {}
group_splits.update(deterministic_split(overlap_shas, 'overlap'))
group_splits.update(deterministic_split(positive_only_shas, 'positive_only'))
assert set(group_splits) == damage_shas

def load_payload(record):
    return json.loads(
        (EXTRACT_ROOT / record['relative_annotation']).read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig')
    )

def load_rgb(record):
    with Image.open(EXTRACT_ROOT / record['relative_image']) as image:
        return image.convert('RGB')

def safe_points(obj):
    points = obj.get('points', {}) if isinstance(obj, dict) else {}
    exterior = points.get('exterior', []) if isinstance(points, dict) else []
    clean = []
    for point in exterior:
        if isinstance(point, (list, tuple)) and len(point) >= 2:
            clean.append((float(point[0]), float(point[1])))
    return clean

def square_box_from_polygon(points, width, height):
    xs = [point[0] for point in points]
    ys = [point[1] for point in points]
    min_x, max_x = min(xs), max(xs)
    min_y, max_y = min(ys), max(ys)
    center_x = (min_x + max_x) / 2.0
    center_y = (min_y + max_y) / 2.0
    minimum_context = min(width, height) * 0.22
    side = max(max_x - min_x, max_y - min_y) * 2.0
    side = int(round(min(max(side, minimum_context), min(width, height))))
    side = max(32, side)
    left = int(round(center_x - side / 2))
    top = int(round(center_y - side / 2))
    left = min(max(left, 0), width - side)
    top = min(max(top, 0), height - side)
    return (left, top, left + side, top + side)

def encode_patch(image, box):
    patch = image.crop(box).resize((PATCH_SIZE, PATCH_SIZE), Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)
    buffer = BytesIO()
    patch.save(
        buffer,
        format='JPEG',
        quality=92,
        subsampling=0,
        optimize=False,
        progressive=False,
    )
    return buffer.getvalue()

def mask_from_annotation(record, size):
    payload = load_payload(record)
    mask = Image.new('1', size, 0)
    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(mask)
    for obj in payload.get('objects', []):
        points = safe_points(obj)
        if len(points) >= 3:
            draw.polygon([(round(x), round(y)) for x, y in points], fill=1)
    return np.asarray(mask, dtype=np.uint8)

def integral_image(array):
    signed = np.asarray(array, dtype=np.int64)
    return np.pad(signed.cumsum(axis=0).cumsum(axis=1), ((1, 0), (1, 0)))

def rectangle_sum(integral, box):
    left, top, right, bottom = box
    return (
        int(integral[bottom, right])
        - int(integral[top, right])
        - int(integral[bottom, left])
        + int(integral[top, left])
    )

def box_iou(first, second):
    left = max(first[0], second[0])
    top = max(first[1], second[1])
    right = min(first[2], second[2])
    bottom = min(first[3], second[3])
    intersection = max(0, right - left) * max(0, bottom - top)
    if intersection == 0:
        return 0.0
    first_area = (first[2] - first[0]) * (first[3] - first[1])
    second_area = (second[2] - second[0]) * (second[3] - second[1])
    return intersection / (first_area + second_area - intersection)

    patch_bytes = encode_patch(image, box)
    patch_sha = hashlib.sha256(patch_bytes).hexdigest()
    if patch_sha in seen_patch_hashes:
        return False
    seen_patch_hashes.add(patch_sha)
    group_sha = source_record['sha256']
    filename = f'{group_sha[:20]}_{kind}_{sequence:02d}.jpg'
    relative_path = Path('patches') / filename
    (PATCH_ROOT / relative_path).write_bytes(patch_bytes)
    manifest_rows.append({
        'image_path': relative_path.as_posix(),
        'label': str(label),
        'group_id': group_sha,
        'source_id': 'hitl_car_parts_damage',

        'crop_box': json.dumps(list(box), separators=(',', ':')),

    })
    return True

for image_index, damage_record in enumerate(damage_records, start=1):
    image = load_rgb(damage_record)
    width, height = image.size
    payload = load_payload(damage_record)
    candidates = []
    for object_index, obj in enumerate(payload.get('objects', [])):
        points = safe_points(obj)
        area = polygon_area(points)
        damage_class = obj.get('classTitle', '') if isinstance(obj, dict) else ''
        if len(points) >= 3 and area > 0 and damage_class in DAMAGE_CLASSES:
            candidates.append({
                'index': object_index,
                'class': damage_class,
                'area': area,
                'points': points,
            })
    assert candidates, f'Aucun polygone exploitable: {damage_record["image_name"]}'

    chosen = []
    chosen_indexes = set()
    for damage_class in class_priority:
        options = [item for item in candidates if item['class'] == damage_class]
        if options and len(chosen) < MAX_POSITIVE_PER_IMAGE:
            best = max(options, key=lambda item: (item['area'], -item['index']))
            chosen.append(best)
            chosen_indexes.add(best['index'])
    if len(chosen) < MAX_POSITIVE_PER_IMAGE:
        for item in sorted(candidates, key=lambda item: (-item['area'], item['index'])):
            if item['index'] not in chosen_indexes:
                chosen.append(item)
                chosen_indexes.add(item['index'])
                if len(chosen) == MAX_POSITIVE_PER_IMAGE:
                    break

    positive_sequence = 0
    for item in chosen:
        box = square_box_from_polygon(item['points'], width, height)
        if add_patch(
            damage_record,
            image,
            box,
            label=1,
            kind='positive',
            sequence=positive_sequence,
            damage_class=item['class'],
        ):
            selected_damage_classes[item['class']] += 1
            positive_sequence += 1

    if damage_record['sha256'] in overlap_shas:
        part_record = records_by_sha[damage_record['sha256']]['parts_candidate_negative']
        part_mask = mask_from_annotation(part_record, (width, height))
        damage_mask = mask_from_annotation(damage_record, (width, height))
        part_integral = integral_image(part_mask)
        damage_integral = integral_image(damage_mask)
        rng = random.Random(int(damage_record['sha256'][:16], 16) ^ SPLIT_SEED)
        min_dimension = min(width, height)
        selected_boxes = []
        attempts = 0
        while len(selected_boxes) < NEGATIVE_PER_OVERLAP_IMAGE and attempts < 5000:
            attempts += 1
            ratio = (0.22, 0.28, 0.36)[rng.randrange(3)]
            side = max(64, min(min_dimension, int(round(min_dimension * ratio))))
            left = rng.randint(0, width - side)
            top = rng.randint(0, height - side)
            box = (left, top, left + side, top + side)
            area = side * side
            part_coverage = rectangle_sum(part_integral, box) / area
            damage_coverage = rectangle_sum(damage_integral, box) / area
            relaxed = attempts > 2500
            minimum_part = 0.30 if relaxed else 0.45
            maximum_iou = 0.55 if relaxed else 0.35
            if part_coverage < minimum_part or damage_coverage > 0.0005:
                continue
            if any(box_iou(box, previous) > maximum_iou for previous in selected_boxes):
                continue
            selected_boxes.append(box)

        negative_sequence = 0
        for box in selected_boxes:
            if add_patch(
                damage_record,
                image,
                box,
                label=0,
                kind='negative',
                sequence=negative_sequence,
            ):
                negative_sequence += 1
        if negative_sequence < NEGATIVE_PER_OVERLAP_IMAGE:
            negative_shortfalls[damage_record['sha256']] = negative_sequence

    if image_index % 100 == 0:

## Lecture du résultat


Un modèle est utilisable uniquement si `release_gate.passed = true` et si les SHA-256 sont valides. Le seuil bloquant est inclusif (`>= 0,75`) pour balanced accuracy, macro-F1 et rappel dommage; ECE doit être `<= 0,08`. La cible PFE reste 0,90.


Même en cas de succès, l'intégration SaaS demeure consultative et fait l'objet d'une PR séparée avec revue humaine, stockage privé et exécution en queue.
